_meanings:
.²1 (As a prefix to verbs and verbal derivatives it means
.³({%a%}) with, together with, together; as in {#saMgam, saMBAzaRa, saMDA, saMyuj#} <ab>&c.</ab>).
.³({%b%}) Sometimes it intensifies the meaning of the simple root, and
 may be translated by ‘very, quite, greatly, thoroughly, very much’; {#saMtuz#},
 {#saMtoza, saMnyas, saMnyAsa, saMtApa#} <ab>&c.</ab>; {#tasyAmAtmAnurUpAyAmAtmajanmasamutsukaH#} <ls>R. 1. 33</ls>.
.³({%c%}) It also expresses completeness, perfection, or beauty.
.²2 As prefixed to nouns to form <ab>comp.</ab> it means ‘like, same, similar’,
 as in {#samarTa#}.
.²3 Sometimes it means ‘near’, ‘before’, as in {#samakza#}.
.²4 In the Vedas it is sometimes used as a separable preposition (with <ab>instr.</ab>).
